summary_1line: A Brahmana and King Ikshvaku share spiritual merit, perform yogic departure, and are equally received by Brahman, proving reciters and yogins attain the same supreme end.

image_candidates.scene_text: A radiant flame bursts from the crown of the meditating Brahmana’s head and ascends toward heaven as gods shower flowers from the sky.
Hosts of gods, sages, rivers, mountains, and celestial musicians gather in the sky while apsaras dance and drums thunder in the heavens.
The Creator Brahman steps forward to welcome a span‑tall shining spirit before receiving it into his mouth amid the assembled deities.
